item.title: Things I Swore I’d Never Do as a Mom… That I Now Do Weekly (if not daily)
item.description: Before I had kids, I was full of wisdom. I judged silently (okay, not that silently) and swore I’d never become that mom — you know, the one bribing their toddler with chocolate at 6:43 AM.Flash forward to now, where I’ve said “Okay, but last one” 47 times and reheated the same coffee cup four times in one morning.Here’s my totally non-exhaustive, slightly shameful list of things I swore I’d never do… but now do on a regular basis.1. item.title: What the Heck Do You Buy a 6-Year-Old?
item.description: (Without Losing Your Mind or Your Wallet)Six is a strange age. They’re not toddlers anymore, but not exactly “big kids” either. They want to be independent...but still need help opening a yogurt. Their interests change weekly, and somehow, they’re extremely passionate about all of them.
